runtime: native HIA policy plus Linux ISA bytes emitted by native HIA

trusted_caller_boundary.event: written only by the reviewed native syscall/clock adapter
trusted_caller_boundary.command_and_state: exclusive private owner memory; never imported as peer-provided authority
trusted_caller_boundary.concurrency: one outstanding command, one operation, one owner; no concurrent FD close/reuse or OFD flag/linger changes
trusted_caller_boundary.descriptor_scope: explicit imported FD, actual fstat device/inode/type, access flags, connected stream options; no authenticated peer identity
trusted_caller_boundary.adoption: borrow proposals while checking; accepted data/cancel slots become owned before F_SETFL; state byte 432 is a cumulative adopted bit mask
trusted_caller_boundary.failed_admission: unadopted descriptors remain caller owned; no nonblock mutation occurs before full class/access/socket validation
trusted_caller_boundary.diagnostic: borrowed optional diagnostic stream; caller authorizes O_NONBLOCK mutation; never closed by reactor
trusted_caller_boundary.aliases: input/output may be distinct FDs for one duplex stream; data/cancel and data/diagnostic object aliases rejected; external OFD aliases outside exclusive contract

api.reactor_tick: (event,command,state)->u32; acknowledge the one actual preceding syscall phase
api.reactor_submit: (event,command,state,mode:u64,amount:u64,absolute_deadline_ns:u64)->u32; quiescent ready context only; retains accepted FDs and epoll
api.reactor_close: (command,state)->u32; quiescent operation only; single-attempt close per owned FD; drive cleanup with tick

return_classes.0: execute exactly the emitted command and return its actual result/phase/time
return_classes.256_plus_status: operation terminal, accepted context retained, repeat tick has no effects
return_classes.128_plus_status: cleanup finished; repeat tick/close has no effects; status retains primary operation outcome, and caller must also inspect close_errors
return_classes.512_plus_status: synchronous call refusal; command/state/ownership unchanged; never means the context has been closed

modes.0: copy exactly amount bytes input to output in bounded windows; at most 2097152 bytes per operation
modes.1: read/drain amount into reused window; at most 2097152; caller can retain a complete read only when amount <= 65536
modes.2: write caller-prepared data window; amount <= 65536; larger output is a sequence of submissions

api.deadline: caller-specified absolute CLOCK_MONOTONIC ns, no implicit reset on retry/resubmit; at most 60 seconds in the future
api.cancellation: 0 disables; otherwise accepted private cancel-read FD >=3; one byte or EOF cancels current operation, checked between every progress attempt
api.cursor: positive actual syscall results advance cursor before deadline evaluation; terminal counts preserve partial effects
api.clock_sampling_failure: apply the acknowledged syscall's positive byte progress/new epoll ownership/registration effects before terminal error; context cannot submit again; cleanup remains required

capability_slots.close_rule: invalidate active/generation before one close command; never retry close EINTR

adapter_profiles.memory: all pointer arguments must be explicit offsets >=128 and ranges contained in 131072-byte command buffer
adapter_profiles.fcntl: F_GETFL with third arg zero, or F_SETFL including O_NONBLOCK
adapter_profiles.socket: SOL_SOCKET SO_TYPE (4 bytes), SO_LINGER (8 bytes), getpeername up to 128 bytes
adapter_profiles.epoll_wait: maxevents exactly 2; timeout 1..100 ms; 24-byte result range
adapter_profiles.epoll_ctl: ADD with 12-byte event or DEL with null event

observation.cause_bits: actual errno bits, class/contract value, or cancellation result; not always an errno
observation.closed_count: number of acknowledged close attempts, including failed close; inspect close_errors; this count alone does not prove release after an error
observation.terminal_ns_on_clock_failure: last successfully sampled monotonic time, not a fabricated failure timestamp
observation.diagnostic_delivery: best effort nonblocking, at most 8 immediate partial/EINTR attempts; EAGAIN/closed channel cannot block termination

cli: program mode amount budget_ms cancel_fd; four bounded decimal arguments; FD0 input, FD1 output, FD2 borrowed diagnostics; CLI mode2 fills deterministic test bytes
policy_contract_fixture: api_fixture.hepta is a native selfhost_exec test entry: 120-byte synthetic event/selector/arguments +69632-byte command +1024-byte state; returns u64 API code + unchanged-size command/state; no modeled errno/FD is claimed to be a real kernel fault
deadline_scope: admitted FIFO/pipe or already connected AF_UNIX/AF_INET/AF_INET6 SOCK_STREAM with SO_LINGER off, nonblocking I/O and kernel epoll timeout
open_boundaries: regular file, block/character device, open/fsync deadlines
